description:
## Problem (reproduced)
Notuning runs never reuse their database. A second notuning DuckDB run logs "❌ Tuning: No tuning metadata found in database → Database is not configured for this run → recreating".

Root cause (plan review F1): notuning runs get a non-None baseline config (`build_baseline_unified_config()`, `benchbox/cli/commands/run.py:1203,2525`). So `_validate_database_tunings` takes the `if effective_config:` branch (`benchbox/platforms/base/tuning_config.py:138-140`) and requires metadata that is never written; `save_tuning_metadata` only runs when tuning is enabled (`adapter.py:1568`). The `else` branch (`tuning_config.py:141-151`) already has the correct notuning semantics, including "Refusing to reuse a tuned database for a notuning run".

## Change
Change the condition to `if effective_config and self.tuning_enabled:`.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- A tuned database is still refused for a notuning run.
- Baseline databases need no metadata table.

## Do not
- Do not write a baseline marker row. The write site would be unreachable and it adds a metadata-store dependency.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
